outreach.subject: The 30-day book system (50 books prove it works)
outreach.body: Most writers spend years on one book. I published 50 in the same time. The difference? A repeatable system. My new course "Write & Publish in 30 Days" gives you the exact framework. Free lesson: [link]. - Saurav
